meta.name: Plainsight Brand Manifest
meta.purpose: Single machine-readable brand spec for humans, tools, and AI agents. When any other document disagrees with this file, this file wins. Agents: read this file whole; never rely on fragments of it.

blue.role: Primary. Headings, dark backgrounds, default text on light.

orange.role: Accent only. CTAs, links, highlights, bullets, badges. Never a full-section or full-slide background.

orange_svg_variant.role: Only appears inside triangle-orange.svg. Do not use as a UI color.

dark_text.role: Body text on light backgrounds (softer navy).

rules: Blue and cream alternate as backgrounds; white is for cards.
Orange is always an accent, never a background fill for a section or slide.
Text on blue = white or light navy. Text on cream = blue or dark text.
All pairings must meet WCAG AA contrast.

headings.style: Bold, uppercase for section headings, wider tracking.

typography.override_note: A file may specify one of these anyway. The deck master's own layouts and theme do (Bahnschrift, Tw Cen MT, Calibri). Override it: this manifest wins over any template, layout, text box or inherited theme. Only the families above are Plainsight typography, with the listed fallbacks when they are not installed.
rules: Maximum 2 font weights per slide or section.
No italics in carousels or slides.
Short blocks: 1-2 sentences per paragraph on slides.

placement.linkedin: Bottom-right, 150 px wide, 36 px from bottom edge. Blue version.
placement.website: Header 160x28 px. Blue on light, white on navy footer.
placement.presentations: Title and closing slides only, bottom-right, matched to slide background.

triangles.rule: The Plainsight triangle is a WIREFRAME OUTLINE with rounded corners. It is never a solid filled triangle. Always place the canonical SVG/PNG files below; never redraw the shape. The SVG paths use a fill attribute internally to paint the outline strokes; that is an implementation detail, not permission to fill the triangle.

placement.principle: Triangles appear in asymmetric pairs at canvas corners, partially cropped: 60% visible, 40% bleeding off the canvas edge. Never centered in a clear frame.

top_right_pair.back: x = canvas_width - triangle_width + 30, y = canvas_height - 0.4 * triangle_height
top_right_pair.front: back position shifted left 90 px and down 60 px

website.navy_sections: Top-right and bottom-left, white at 5-10% opacity. CTA and footer only.

placement.presentations: Corner decoration only, subtle, never obscuring content.

hard_rules: Never fill the triangle with a solid color.
Never redraw or approximate the triangle; place the asset files.
Only three colors exist: blue, orange, white.
One motif per piece: triangles or rocket, not both.
No triangle larger than one third of the page. Accents, not heroes.
Decorative only: never obscure text or interactive content (pointer-events: none, aria-hidden).

rules: Do not combine with triangles in one piece.

powerpoint_master.name: 2026 PowerPoint template (rebranding)
powerpoint_master.live_version: SharePoint > Plainsight > General > Digital Templates > Office Templates > 2026_PWP Sjabloon Plainsight rebranding.potx
powerpoint_master.rule: All Plainsight decks start from this template. Do not rebuild slide layouts from scratch. SharePoint holds the live version; the bundled file is a snapshot.

known_issues.also_affects: the live SharePoint version of the same template
known_issues.problem: The layouts and text boxes carry fonts that are not Plainsight typography. The bundled snapshot's four themes use Bahnschrift, Tw Cen MT, Calibri Light and Calibri; the live SharePoint file additionally has Quicksand Light on layout text boxes and resists being changed there.
known_issues.rule: Start from the template for the layouts and the geometry, then set type from typography above. Never keep the inherited font because the template offered it.

voice.summary: Senior practitioners who respect the reader's time. Knowledge first, in clear human language. We must never sound like AI wrote it, and never sound like every other consultancy.

principles.name: Clear, not clever
principles.detail: Short sentences. Plain English or plain Dutch. Trade the buzzword for the thing it describes.

principles.name: Concrete, not vague
principles.detail: Numbers, timeframes, named technologies. '30% faster' beats 'significantly faster'.

principles.name: Confident, not loud
principles.detail: No caps-shouting, no stacked exclamation marks. The work speaks; we describe it.

principles.name: Expert, not jargon
principles.detail: For output leaving Plainsight, keep technical language light. Show expertise through concrete examples and honest observations, not through vocabulary.

hard_rules: No em dashes or en dashes as separators. Use commas, periods, or restructure.
No AI-style anecdote openers ('This was my Tuesday morning', 'I'm thrilled to announce').
No dramatic rule-of-three ('innovation, inspiration, and impact'). Use the natural number of items.
No numbered lists of obvious advice, no generic conclusions ('The future looks bright'), no signposting.
If a sentence could appear on any consultancy's feed, rewrite it or cut it.

culture: Transparent by default: we say what we do, why, and what comes next.
We share feedback openly, and knowledge beyond the boundaries of our own organisation.
Not corporate, no hierarchy in tone. Taking responsibility means ownership, not being the boss of someone else.
sound_like: Smart friend over coffee, not a press release
voice.linkedin: Knowledge-sharing first: every post should teach something, from a practitioner's perspective. One point per post, made well, under 150 words. Concrete examples from real situations. Never sound like all the others.

agent_checklist: Background is cream #fcf8f3 or blue #000075, never orange.
Triangles placed from asset files, wireframe, rounded, in asymmetric corner pairs, 60% visible.
Max 2 font weights; headings Titillium Web bold uppercase, body Inter.
If a template, layout or text box specifies another font, override it to the typography above: the deck master does this and it is a known defect.
Logo from asset files, correct variant for the background.
Decks start from the official .potx template.
Copy passes the voice test: clear, concrete, confident; no buzzwords, no banned words, no em dashes.
One motif (triangles or rocket), decorations never obscure content.
